name: yaps
description: Local transcription, meeting notes, captions, subtitles, voice, translation, and media tools powered by the Yaps desktop app.
long_description:
Bring the installed Yaps desktop app's on-device media engines into Claude Desktop. Every job runs locally on your computer through Yaps - nothing in this extension uploads your recordings, videos, images, or text anywhere.

- **Transcription and subtitles**: transcribe audio or video to plain text, or generate timestamped .srt subtitle files.
- **Meeting transcription**: speaker-labelled meeting transcripts you can correct, reassign, rename, merge, summarize, chapter, question, and export.
- **Auto Captions**: build an editable caption project from a video, fix and restyle captions in chat, then burn them into a new MP4.
- **Audio Cleaner**: remove background noise, hiss, and static from speech recordings.
- **Voice**: synthesize text into WAV speech files with local Kokoro, Chatterbox, or multilingual Supertonic voices.
- **Translation**: translate text, Markdown, plain-text, and SRT files entirely on-device.
- **Media utilities**: extract a video's audio track, or cut an image's subject onto a transparent background.
- **Dictation**: check system-wide voice typing readiness and recover recent dictations.

Requires the free-to-download Yaps desktop app (https://www.yaps.ai/download, version 2.3.124 or newer) signed in with an active trial or Yaps Pro.
